m_about: What the original game had and Starflight Game Data.json does not, recovered from Research/Data/STRINFO.DOC. Texts are as STRINFO prints them (in capitals, with its brackets for values the game fills in). A planet is given as STRINFO gives it: the star by its coordinates and the planet by its number counted from the sun (m_planetFromSun; this holds in 17 of the 18 STRINFO entries that also print an orbit number, the 18th is Koann). Latitude is positive to the north, longitude positive to the east; m_placement says whether a message is at its coordinates (Site), at random places on the planet (Random) or at several places (Several). m_note records corrections and conflicts, m_source the section of STRINFO. Comm ids start at 1000 so that they never meet the ids of the game data.

m_planetMessageList.m_text: REPORT - TO COLONY CONTROL AT 16S x 20W, PLANET 4, SYSTEM 118, 146 - DUE TO THE INCREASED DEMAND FOR HYPER-TRITICALE AND THE RECENT INFESTATION OF SMALL FURRY CREATURES WHICH HAVE DEPLETED OUR STOCK WE. . .
MICROFILM -. . .REASON TO BELIEVE THERE IS A BLACK EGG DEVICE IN SOME PHLEGMAK RUINS AT 52N x 16E ON THE THIRD PLANET OF SYSTEM 238, 189. . .

NOTES - . . . INFORMATION    HAS    SUCCESSFULLY    PINPOINTED    THE TESSERACT ENERGY ENHANCER AND THE RED CYLINDER ANCIENT-RUIN LOCATER DEVICE AT 15N x 44W ON PLANET 5 OF SYSTEM 18, 50 , AND AT 59N x 64W ON PLANET 3 OF SYSTEM 112, 200 RESPECTIVELY. . .
SOME ARCANE AND INDECIPHERABLE PHLEGMAK WRITING.

CAPTAIN'S LOG ENTRY - OCTOBER 31, 3480 - WE HAVE MANAGED TO SET UP A CAMP OF SORTS HERE, AND HAVE ENOUGH SUPPLIES TO KEEP US ALIVE FOR SEVERAL MONTHS.  WE WERE ON OUR WAY TO ESTABLISH THE NOAH 9 COLONY WORLD OF 'HEAVEN' WHEN THE SHIP BLEW.
THE MECHANS ARE CURRENTLY IN PREPARATION PHASE CODE BLUE.  OUR ARRIVAL WOULD HAVE INITIATED CODE RED, AND WE WOULD HAVE TAKEN CONTROL OF THE MECHANS.  I BELIEVE OUR SHIP WAS SABOTAGED BY THE LAYTONITES, DAMN THEM.  HALF OF MY CREW IS DEAD.
THEIR BOMB BLEW OUT THE ENTIRE AFT QUARTER SECTION OF THE SHIP.  I DON'T KNOW HOW WE MADE IT DOWN TO THE SURFACE IN THAT DEFECTIVE POD.  I JUST HOPE OUR LUCK HOLDS OUT.  CAPTAIN OUT.
m_planetMessageList.m_note: Planet 1 of 175,94 is in orbit 3 (STRINFO 5.1, the Noah 9 wreck site).

m_planetMessageList.m_text: INSTITUTE RESEARCH REPORT TO ELOWAN HOMEWORLD BASE 60S x 45E - WE HAVE ASCERTAINED THAT THE DEAD ZONE IS COREWARD OF THE X-COORDINATE 200.  WE HAVE ALSO DETERMINED THAT THE CAUSE OF THE FLARES IS SOMEWHERE COREWARD AND UPSPIN OF OUR PRESENT LOCATION. . .
PAPERS - HARRISON HAS ONCE AGAIN BEEN SUCCESSFUL IN HIS LATEST RAID.  THIS TIME THE ATTACK WAS ON SIX EMPIRE CARGO SHIPS BOUND FOR. . .
NEWSPAPER - . . .  OF THE EMPIRE NOW SUSPECT THAT HARRISON'S BASE IS HERE ON NEW SCOTLAND AND THAT HIS TROOPS ARE SECRETED HERE AMONGST OUR POPULATION. . .
ORDERS - . . . REPORT  IMMEDIATELY  TO  BASE  59N x 22E  FOR  NEW ORDERS FROM HARRISON.  THE NEXT. . .

REPORT - . . . HAVE  FINALLY  LOCATED HARRISON'S BASE OF OPERATIONS ON NEW SCOTLAND, AND ONCE AGAIN HE'S A STEP AHEAD OF US.  WE BELIEVE HE MAY HAVE RELOCATED AT 44S x 137W ON THE FIRST PLANET OF SYSTEM 81, 98.  WE WILL PROCEED TO. . .
COORDINATE LISTING - . . . AT 59N x 22E, BASE 2 AT 54N x 13E DOMICILE AT . . .
NEWSPAPER - JULY 1, 3476 - THE EMPEROR OF THE UNITED STATES ANNOUNCED THAT THE ROYAL FAMILY WILL BE ON HAND AT THIS YEAR'S 17TH CENTENNIAL CELEBRATION TO BE HELD IN THE CAPITOL AT DISNEYLAND.
NEWSPAPER - JAN 28, 3478 - SCIENTISTS EXPECT CANCER CURE BREAKTHROUGH ANY DAY. . .
NEWSPAPER - MARCH 22, 3477 - NEW GOVERNMENT TAX HIKE TO GO INTO EFFECT.  EFFECTIVE THIS APRIL MIDDLE INCOME FAMILIES CAN EXPECT TO PAY 260% OF THEIR ANNUAL INCOME IN TAXES.
MAGAZINE - MAY 3, 3450 - IN AN INTERVIEW YESTERDAY GEORGE SCHMENGE, THE DONOR FOR THE FIRST SUCCESSFUL BRAIN TRANSPLANT HAD LITTLE TO SAY.

ANCIENT HISTORY TEXT BOOK - . . . IN PRIMITIVE SOCIETIES IT BECAME POPULAR FOR A SHORT TIME TO SIT COUNTLESS HOURS IN FRONT OF 2 DIMENSIONAL PHOSPHOR SCREENS AND LIVE OUT FANTASIES.  MANY HISTORIANS BELIEVE THIS ACTIVITY MARKED THE DOWNFALL OF CIVILIZATION.
SIGN - FIRST CHURCH OF THE LAST LAUGH.  TODAY'S SERMON - SO FAR, SO WHAT?

NEWSPAPER - 3404 - LOVELY LUNAR LANSCAPES.  OWN YOUR OWN HOME IN THOSE FINAL YEARS AFTER RETIREMENT.  LIVE IN QUIET SERENITY BY THE SEA OF TRANQUILITY.  CRATERSIDE HOMES ARE NOW AVAILABLE AND START AT ONLY 699,000,000.  SENIOR CITIZENS 200 YRS AND UP ONLY.

NEWSPAPER - NOVEMBER 20, 3450 - . . . THE EQUAL RIGHTS AMENDMENT FOR ANDROIDS WAS FINALLY RATIFIED LAST FRIDAY.  THERE IS STILL SUBSTANTIAL CONTROVERSY, HOWEVER, OVER THE PROPOSED EQUAL RIGHTS AMENDMENT FOR WOMEN.

NEWSPAPER - FEB. 8, 3465 - . . . THE DEATH OF JOHNNY BEAVER MARKED THE EXTINCTION OF THE LAST ANIMAL SPECIES OTHER THAN MAN ON EARTH.  THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY WAS FORCED TO CLOSE DOWN DUE TO THE LACK OF ANY ENVIRONMENT TO PROTECT.

NEWSPAPER - APRIL 1, 3465 - A REPRESENTATIVE FROM CMIS, CHRISTIAN MISSIONARIES IN SPACE, REPORTS THE SUCCESSFUL CONVERSION OF AN ENTIRE PLANET OF QUASI-HUMANOIDS IN THE OMEGA SECTOR.  'ONCE AGAIN WE HAVE SAVED A RACE FROM THEIR NATIVE CULTURAL DEPRAVITY.'
INVOICE - . . . SECOND SHIPMENT OF IRIDIUM TO ARRIVE AT 56N x 16W H.Q. ON MARDAN 2 NO LATER THAN THE THIRD DAY OF. . .

LOG - . . . PEOPLE ARE PANICKING.  THE SOLAR FLARES ARE INTENSIFYING.  THE BEST ESTIMATES GIVE US 3 DAYS AT THE OUTSIDE.  LOG ENTRY        2-28-3480 SURFACE TEMP. IT IS AT 150 DEGREES C., ONLY BEING THIS FAR UNDERGROUND HAS KEPT US ALIVE THIS LONG. . .
CORNERSTONE INSCRIPTION - BEN AND ANNA'S ACADEMY OF INDEPENDENT THINKING
SIGN - STARFLIGHT NAVIGATIONAL RESEARCH STATION
NOTICE - TO ALL PERSONNEL - EARTH BASE ONE, AT 12N x 104W IS TEMPORARILY QUARANTINED DUE TO. . .
REQUEST - MINING STATIONS 25 THROUGH 158 ON PLANET 4 REQUEST IMMEDIATE SUPPLIES.  WE ARE. . .
LETTER - . . . HEREBY REQUEST THAT THE RESEARCHERS AT THE MARS POLAR STATION BE DIRECTED TO LOOK INTO THIS AND. . .
SIGN - MARDAN 4 MINING STATION NO. 82
SIGN - MARDAN 4 MINING STATION NO. 17
m_planetMessageList.m_note: STRINFO: "several locations" on this planet, and NO. [NUMBER]: its editor's field for the station number. The number 17 is the shipped game's own: its message records have this sign twice, NO. 82 (message 28) and NO. 17 (the decompiled original, s-macke/starflight-reverse, starflt1-out/data/instance.txt).
m_planetMessageList.m_source: STRINFO 3.1; the shipped game's message record

m_planetMessageList.m_text: INTELLIGENCE COMMUNICATION - . . . SHIP WAS ATTACKED BY THE GAZURTOID.  ALL CREW WERE KILLED AND THE NEW CLOAKING DEVICE WAS STOLEN.  A PROBE WAS ABLE TO TRACK THEIR SHIP'S TACHYON TRAIL TO THE SYSTEM 68, 66.  OTHER THAN THAT WE DON'T. . .
RECONNAISSANCE REPORT - TO OFFENSIVE HEADQUARTERS AT 56N x 16W ON MARDAN 2 - FIGHTING BETWEEN THE VELOX AND GAZURTOID IS STILL HEATED.  WE HAVE BEEN KEEPING A LOW PROFILE AND. . .
WRITING IN A VARIANT OF OLD EMPIRE ENGLISH - . . . HARRISON HAS LANDED AND BUILT STRUCTURES AT 44S x 137W.  TO ENSURE OUR SAFETY WE MUST REPORT HIM TO THE EMPIRE. . .
THE ONLY THING DECIPERABLE IN SOME ALIEN WRITINGS ARE PLANETARY COORDINATES 12N x 32E.
AMIDST  FILES  OF  ALIEN  BOOKS SOME WRITING FROM THE OLD EMPIRE - . . . THE PYTHAGORAS CONSTELLATION AT 216, 87. . .
SIGN - RONALD PETER GAAL MEMORIAL RESEARCH STATION.

REPORT - PROJECT TELEPORT, 1-2-3380 - . . . IN SHORT WE HAVE DEVISED A SCHEME TO TELEPORT AN OPERATIVE FROM A SPECIALLY BUILT STARBASE (WHICH WILL BE KNOWN AS CRYSTAL BASE 1) TO THE SURFACE OF THE CRYSTAL PLANET.
BECAUSE OF THE PROBLEMS INVOLVED WITH A TELEPORTATION OF THIS DISTANCE WE WILL NOT BE ABLE TO RETRIEVE THE OPERATIVE.  THE VOLUNTEER WILL BE SENT IN WITH A NUCLEAR EXPLOSIVE.  IF POSSIBLE HE WILL STAY IN COMMUNICATION WITH THE STARBASE.
HE WILL LOCATE AND DESTROY THE CONTROL CENTER OF THE CRYSTAL PLANET.  POTENTIAL PROBLEMS INCLUDE - TELEPORTATION RELIABILITY, INSUFFICIENT EXPLOSIVE POWER, COMMUNICATIONS THROUGH THE MAGNETIC FIELD GENERATED BY THE PLANET, LOCATION OF. . .
COMMUNICATION TRANSCRIPT  -  CRYSTAL BASE 1 TO AKTERON INSTITUTE, 8-8-3382. . . BEEN 14 HOURS SINCE COMMANDER MCCONNELL WAS SENT DOWN.  AT NO POINT HAVE WE RECEIVED ANY COMMUNICATION FROM HIM.
AT EXACTLY 12 HRS AND 11 MINUTES AFTER HIS DEPARTURE WE WITNESSED AN EXPLOSION ON THE PLANET'S SURFACE.  WE ARE NOW SENDING OUT DRONES TO TEST THE DEFENSES OF THE CRYSTAL PLANET IN AN ATTEMPT TO ASCERTAIN THE EFFECT OF THE EXPLOSION. . .
RESEARCH COUNCIL RECOMMENDATION 5-5-3386 - . . . THEREFORE IT IS OUR FINDING THAT THE ONLY EFFECTIVE MEANS OF DESTROYING THE CRYSTAL PLANET IS WITH THE USE OF 3 DEVICES.  THE FIRST OF THESE, THE CRYSTAL ORB, IS NEEDED TO NULLIFY THE DEFENSES OF THE PLANET.  THIS IS IN THE POSSESSION OF THE VELOX AND IS KNOWN TO THEM AS THE SMALL EGG.  THE SECOND DEVICE IS THE CRYSTAL CONE.  THIS IS NEEDED TO IDENTIFY FROM ORBIT THE LOCATION OF THE CONTROL NEXUS, AND IS KNOWN TO BE AT COORDINATES 29S x 55W ON THE FIRST PLANET IN SYSTEM 20, 198.  UNFORTUNATELY THIS IS DEEP IN UHLEK SPACE.  THE CRYSTAL PLANET IS ONLY VULNERABLE AT THE CONTROL NEXUS.  LASTLY, A BOMB OF SUFFICIENT EXPLOSIVE POWER IS REQUIRED.  THE ACTUAL FORCE NECESSARY IS UNKNOWN BUT OUR BEST ESTIMATES INDICATE SOMETHING ON THE ORDER OF BEVA-TONS.

LOG ENTRY 8-8-3382, COMMANDER MCCONNELL, ENTRY 1 - I HAVE SUCCESSFULLY TELEPORTED TO THE CRYSTAL PLANET!  I AM DIZZY AND HAVE EXPERIENCED A PROFOUND SENSE OF DISORIENTATION BUT OTHER THAN THAT I SEEM TO BE FINE.  THE CONTROL NEXUS IS VISIBLE FROM HERE.
ENTRY 2 - IT WOULD SEEM THAT THE ELECTRO-MAGNETIC FIELD AROUND THE CRYSTAL PLANET IS, IN FACT, BLOCKING COMMUNICATIONS SINCE IT HAS BEEN AN HOUR AND I HAVE STILL RECEIVED NO TRANSMISSION FROM CRYSTAL BASE 1.
ENTRY 2 CONT. - I AM THEREFORE WRITING IN THIS LOG AS PLANNED, AND WILL ATTEMPT TO FIND A SAFE PLACE FOR IT BEFORE THE EXPLOSION.
ENTRY 3 - I HAVE REACHED THE CONTROL CENTER AND HAVE SET THE CHARGES.  IT APPEARS TO BE A MASSIVE RUIN OF THE ANCIENTS.  THE QUEER CRYSTALLINE LUMPS OF ENDURIUM ARE EVERYWHERE HERE.
ENTRY 4 - I HAVE JUST HAD AN ASTOUNDING EXPERIENCE!  I CAN HARDLY BELIEVE IT BUT I SEEM TO HAVE MADE TELEPATHIC CONTACT WITH THE ANCIENTS.  THEY ARE HERE!  ON THE CRYSTAL PLANET, CONTROLLING IT!
ENTRY 4 CONT. - I WISH THERE WAS SOME WAY FOR ME TO COMMUNICATE WHAT I HAVE FOUND.  THE EXPLOSION IS SET FOR T-MINUS 40 MINUTES.  IN THE EVENT THAT THE CRYSTAL PLANET IS NOT DESTROYED, I CAN ONLY HOPE THAT THIS LOG IS FOUND BY SOMEONE.
ENTRY 4 CONT.- I CAN HARDLY BELIEVE IT!  THOSE WEIRD LUMPS ARE ACTUALLY INTELLIGENT LIFE.  THE ANCIENTS ARE ENDURIUM!  AND WE HAVE SPENT HUNDREDS OF YEARS HUNTING THEM TO BURN FOR FUEL IN OUR SHIPS.
ENTRY 4 CONT.- THEIR METABOLISM IS SO MUCH SLOWER THAN OURS THEY LIVE IN AN ENTIRELY DIFFERENT TIME FRAMEWORK.  I DON'T THINK THEY EVEN KNOW WE ARE SENTIENT.  I BELIEVE IT WAS ONLY BECAUSE OF A LINK THRU THE CRYSTAL PLANET THAT CONTACT WAS MADE AT ALL.
ENTRY 4 CONT.- THIS CRYSTAL PLANET WAS THEIR LAST DEFENSE.  I CAN HARDLY BLAME THEM.  CARBON BASED LIFE MUST HAVE SEEMED SOMETHING LIKE A VIRUS TO THEM.  JUST THE SAME, I HOPE THE EXPLOSION WORKS.  IT LOOKS LIKE AT THIS POINT IT'S US OR THEM.  MCCONNELL OUT.

m_artifactSiteList.m_note: A Veloxi drone guards this planet from orbit (encounter 302).

m_artifactSiteList.m_text: Phlegmak ruins (the microfilm message on planet 3 of Arth's system).
Deep in Uhlek space (the Akteron 6 report).
Sphexi. Within a recent ruin in the center of a circular formation of 6 ancient ruins known as the Most Magnificent Hexagon.
m_artifactSiteList.m_note: Veloxi drones guard Sphexi from orbit (encounter 305).

m_artifactSiteList.m_text: Within a recent ruin in the southwest of a cluster of 15 ancient ruins known as the City of the Ancients.

m_artifactSiteList.m_note: A message at 17N x 162E on planet 2 of 123,101 names 16S x 20W on this planet as colony control; the intelligence message lies at 15S x 20W.

STRINFO 4.1 prints system 215, 88 with the tag [EARTH]. Earth is planet 3 of 215, 86 everywhere else in STRINFO (3.1, 5.1), and the Earth message of 3.1 lies at the same 11N x 104W, so 215, 86 is taken.

STRINFO prints planet 4 here, in 1.2 and in 5.1, but names it Koann 3, its 5.1 entry gives orbit number 5 (the third planet from the sun of 112, 200), and the former Elowan homeworld notes (3.1) say planet 3. Ruled 2026-10-09 by the owner: the third planet (roadmap D5).
The sign of the Starflight navigational research station is at the same place (3.1).

STRINFO contradicts itself: 4.1 puts the Rod Device at 59N x 22E, Harrison's base 1; New Scotland's entry in 5.1 says his first base is at 59N x 22E, the second at 54N x 13E, and the Rod Device is at the latter. Ruled 2026-10-09 by the owner: 54N x 13E (roadmap D5).
A message on this planet (3.1) gives the coordinates as 12N x 32E. Gazurtoids (encounter 33) wait in orbit.

m_colonyEvaluationList.m_note: STRINFO prints planet 4 of 112, 200; the third planet (orbit 5) is taken, as for the Red Cylinder site (ruled 2026-10-09 by the owner, roadmap D5).
STRINFO prints the bonus as "55OOO" (letter O for zero).
STRINFO: It is guarded by a veloxi drone.

m_storyTextList.m_text: GOOD WORK!  YOU HAVE LOCATED AN OPTIMAL PLANET.  YOU HAVE EARNED A BONUS OF [REWARD] MU'S FOR THIS RECOMMENDATION.
m_storyTextList.m_note: [REWARD] is the bonus of the planet (the colony evaluation list).

m_storyTextList.m_text: THIS PLANET PROVED TO BE SUITABLE FOR COLONIZATION.  YOU HAVE EARNED A BONUS OF [REWARD] MU'S FOR THIS RECOMMENDATION.
m_storyTextList.m_note: [REWARD] is the bonus of the planet (the colony evaluation list).

m_storyTextList.m_text: DUE TO [REASON:  EXTREME HEAT, EXTREME COLD, CRUSHING GRAVITY, VIOLENT STORMS, LACK OF WATER, AND/OR LACK OF OXYGEN], THIS PLANET PROVED UNSUITABLE FOR COLONIZATION.  YOU HAVE BEEN FINED 100 MU'S.  THIS IS ONLY A WARNING, YOUR NEXT FINE WILL BE HEAVY.
m_storyTextList.m_note: STRINFO: later fines vary with how unsuitable the planet is for colonization. The reasons it lists: extreme heat, extreme cold, crushing gravity, violent storms, lack of water, lack of oxygen.

m_storyTextList.m_text:
SUPPLEMENTAL EVALUATION
SUBJECT:  COMPLETION OF MISSION

CONGRATULATIONS!  AS A RESULT OF YOUR EFFORTS, OUR SUN IS ONCE AGAIN STABLE.  ALL OF ARTH, AND INDEED THE ENTIRE GALAXY OWES YOU A DEBT WHICH CAN NEVER BE FULLY REPAID.  YOUR HEROIC EXPLOITS WILL SURELY BECOME INTER-GALACTIC LEGEND.
OUR TOKEN BONUS OF 500,000 MU WILL ALLOW YOU TO LIVE HERE ON ARTH IN LUXURY FOR MANY YEARS TO COME, ALTHOUGH WE SUSPECT YOU MAY USE IT TO FURTHER YOUR EXPLORATIONS.  ONCE AGAIN, THANK YOU!
m_storyTextList.m_note: A supplemental evaluation at the Starport after the Crystal Planet is destroyed.

m_storyTextList.m_text:
SUPPLEMENTAL EVALUATION
SUBJECT:  LOSS OF TERRAIN VEHICLE

DUE TO YOUR NEGLIGENCE, YOUR SHIP IS NO LONGER EQUIPPED WITH A TERRAIN VEHICLE.  A NEW TERRAIN VEHICLE IS CURRENTLY BEING INSTALLED.  CONSEQUENTLY, YOU HAVE BEEN FINED 10,000 MU.
m_storyTextList.m_note: A supplemental evaluation. STRINFO prints "CONSEQUENLY"; the shipped game says CONSEQUENTLY (OP-OV in the decompiled original, s-macke/starflight-reverse).

m_storyTextList.m_text:
SUPPLEMENTAL EVALUATION
SUBJECT:  TOWING CHARGES

I.S. CORP. REG.  12A-7312 EMERGENCY DISTRESS CALLS:  CAPTAIN AND CREW OF ANY VESSEL INVOKING AN EMERGENCY DISTRESS CALL SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ALL COSTS INCURRED BY INTERSTEL CORP. AS A RESULT OF RESCUE OPERATIONS INITIATED ON BEHALF OF SAID CREW.  YOU HAVE BEEN FINED  [AMOUNT] MU.
m_storyTextList.m_note: STRINFO: fines vary directly with the distance from Arth and range from 15000 to 80000 MU. STRINFO prints "LIABLE FOR ANY COSTS" and "ON BEHALF SAID CREW"; the words here are the shipped game's (OP-OV in the decompiled original).

m_storyTextList.m_text:
INCOMING HIGH PRIORITY MESSAGE
IT IS WITH THE SINCEREST GRATITUDE FROM THE PEOPLE OF ARTH AND THE STOCKHOLDERS OF INTERSTEL THAT I PRESENT TO YOU AND YOUR HEROIC CREW THE INTERSTEL MEDAL OF SUBLIME ACHIEVEMENT, THE HIGHEST MEDAL ACCORDED TO INTERSTEL CONTRACTORS.
THIS AWARD INCLUDES A SPECIAL BONUS OF 500,000 MU WHEN YOU RETURN TO TO STARPORT.  THANK YOU FOR SAVING EVERYTHING THAT WE HOLD DEAR. --
LEIGH V. MALONE, CHAIRMAN OF INTERSTEL.  END TRANSMISSION)
m_storyTextList.m_note: Detonating a Black Egg at the control nexus of the Crystal Planet (47N x 45E on planet 1 of 192, 152). STRINFO: this message is received even after the Starport has been destroyed.

m_storyTextList.m_text: CRYSTAL PLANET DAMAGED BUT NOT DESTROYED
m_storyTextList.m_note: Detonating a Black Egg anywhere else on the Crystal Planet.

m_storyTextList.m_text:
STAR IN SYSTEM [XX, YY]
FLARED ON STARDATE
[DD-MM-YY]
THE ISS [VESSEL NAME]
AND CREW WERE INCINERATED.
GAME OVER
m_storyTextList.m_note: [XX, YY] are the coordinates of the star, [DD-MM-YY] the stardate, [VESSEL NAME] the name of the ship.
A distress signal after the Starport has been destroyed.

m_storyTextList.m_text: CAPTAIN, WE ARE RECEIVING A COUNTDOWN TRANSMISSION FROM THE BLACK EGG...
m_storyTextList.m_note: Then 5 to 1, one number to a line, and BOOM!, and the planet is gone from the view. Seen in orbit above the Uhlek mind-ganglion's planet.

m_storyTextList.m_text: CAPTAIN, I FELT A TREMOR AS IF MILLIONS OF VOICES CRIED OUT AND WERE SUDDENLY SILENCED.
m_storyTextList.m_note: A crew member, when a Black Egg destroys Elan, the homeworld of the Elowan (planet 2 of 148, 63).

m_storyTextList.m_text: CAPTAIN, ALL ALIEN COMMUNICATIONS IN THE LOCAL VICINITY HAVE CEASED!
m_storyTextList.m_note: A crew member, when a Black Egg destroys the planet of the Uhlek mind-ganglion (planet 2 of 55, 32). STRINFO: the Uhlek are rendered harmless.

m_ruinFormationList.m_text: THE CRYSTAL ORB IS FOUND WITHIN A RECENT RUIN IN THE CENTER OF A CIRCULAR FORMATION OF 6 ANCIENT RUINS KNOWN AS 'THE MOST MAGNIFICENT HEXAGON'.
m_ruinFormationList.m_note: STRINFO gives the count and the shape, not the size: the port puts the six ruins 48 units from the Orb's ruin.

m_ruinFormationList.m_text: THE CRYSTAL PEARL IS FOUND WITHIN A RECENT RUIN IN THE SOUTHWEST OF A CLUSTER OF 15 ANCIENT RUINS KNOWN AS 'THE CITY OF THE ANCIENTS'.
m_ruinFormationList.m_note: STRINFO gives the count and that the Pearl's ruin is in the southwest, not the layout: the port puts the 15 ruins in rows of 4, 40 units apart, north and east of the Pearl's ruin, which takes the southwest corner of the block.

m_ancientRuinSiteList.m_text: THERE IS AN ANCIENT RUIN AT THIS LOCATION ON PLANET 5 OF SYSTEM 145, 107, WHICH CONTAINS 3.1 CUBIC METERS OF ENDURIUM.  NOTHING ELSE OF NOTE IS THERE.
m_ancientRuinSiteList.m_note: The Mechans' line it answers: WE HAVE DISCOVERED SOME RUINS AT 36N x 90E ON THE ICE PLANET IN OUR SYSTEM.

m_ancientRuinSiteList.m_text: THERE ARE INDEED TWO ANCIENT RUINS AT THIS LOCATION, WITHIN A VAST OCEAN, CONTAINING 3.1 CUBIC METERS AND 5.9 CUBIC METERS OF ENDURIUM, RESPECTIVELY.  THERE IS NOTHING ELSE OF NOTE THERE.
m_ancientRuinSiteList.m_note: The Thrynn's line it answers: A FAIRLY LARGE ANCIENT RUIN AT 42S x 13W ON PLANET 2 OF SYSTEM 154, 62. STRINFO puts both ruins at the one place; the port puts the second 40 units east of the first.
